entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'New Orders'.
Returns.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor I bought. I need to return it, but I'm pretty sure I'm past the return date. I was hoping you could help, as I had a family emergency.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear about your emergency. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF778-1215-2501.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now. And just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, it's just preference. The band itself is fine. Right after I got it, my father had to be rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery. I've been helping with his recovery and just haven't used it.
I see. I hope your father's surgery went well and he's recovering smoothly.

Thank you. He is. But on top of that, my brother's overseas deployment got moved up, so I've been focused on family. I just don't have the time or energy for it now. I know I'm late, but could we maybe work out a store credit or something? I'd be happy with even a partial refund.
I completely understand, that's a lot to handle at once. Let me just check the policy for your order. One moment... Okay, I see you received the item on December 15th, which was 28 days ago.
Right, I figured it was too late.
Actually, according to our policy in the system, all VeloFit items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I was certain it was something like 14 days. That's a huge relief.

Yes, so there's no need for any special exception. I can process a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Wow, that's fantastic. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was prepared to negotiate for a discount code. I really appreciate you making that so simple.
Of course, Alex. I'm glad I could resolve this for you easily. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get less hectic for you soon.
